description: This file manages token storage and retrieval in local storage for authentication purposes in a React-based web application. It provides functions to get, set, and clear access and refresh tokens, handling legacy keys for backward compatibility. It also normalizes token strings and strips out 'Bearer' prefixes if present.

methods.name: normalizeStoredToken
methods.description: Normalizes a token string by trimming and treating empty or 'null'/'undefined' strings as null.

methods.name: stripBearerPrefix
methods.description: Removes the 'Bearer' prefix from tokens if present, after normalization.
